title: Compensation Basis for a Late Recovery Reset
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts

**Basis by lateness.** The compensation basis of the late-reset goodwill depends on how late the reset was, counted in the days the reset was late (the calendar days from the request's decision date to the date of the security-change notice, less the waiting period in days): where those days are 7 or more, the basis is $12.00 for each started week of those days; where they are 3 or more but fewer than 7, the basis is $7.00 flat; where they are fewer than 3, the basis is $1.50 for each of those days.

A started week counts in full, so 8 late days are two started weeks and 15 late days are three.

| Days the reset was late | Basis |
|---|---|
| 2 | $3.00 |
| 3 | $7.00 |
| 6 | $7.00 |
| 8 | $24.00 |
| 15 | $36.00 |
